summary: Taiwan's story is the AI chip boom. On Oct 15 TSMC reported Q3 revenue of $46.72 billion, up 41.2%, and guided Q4 to $52.3 to $54.3 billion, saying AI demand is far above supply. But investors now doubt the spenders will keep paying: on Oct 30 the Taiex fell 1,156.50 points, or 2.49%, to 45,211.83, its lowest in over two months, and foreign investors sold a net NT$112.47 billion (Focus Taiwan, Trading Economics). TSMC fell 1.86% to NT$2,370 in Taipei, and its ADR closed at 431.81 on Oct 29, down 1.75% (Focus Taiwan, Massive). The main local risks remain China-Taiwan tension or US chip tariffs; no new tension was found this week.
for_you: No new Taiwan puts or buys while foreigners are selling this hard. TSMC's own guidance has not changed, so this is a price problem, not a business problem, for now.

changes.what: TSMC reported September sales of NT$511.9 billion, up 54.6% from a year ago, and record Q3 sales of NT$1.494 trillion, above the NT$1.46 trillion LSEG estimate. AI chip demand is still rising.

The Taiex fell 1.95% to 48,341 on Oct 13 as foreign investors sold a net NT$165 billion, the third largest foreign sale on record, after the US chip selloff and Korea's crash. TSMC fell 1.97% to NT$2,490 two days before its results.
changes.for_you: EWT dropped off the Setups list; no swing until after TSMC reports. The call is 2:00pm Taipei time Thursday, which is 2:00am ET. TSM is left out of the bearish list because its sales are still up over 50%; this is foreign money leaving, not a business change.

changes.what: TSMC beat and raised (Q3 revenue $46.72 billion, gross margin 66.4%, 2026 growth now about 44%, capex unchanged at $60 to $64 billion), yet its shares fell about 2% and the Taiex had its sixth steepest point drop with a record NT$302.56 billion of net foreign selling on Oct 15.
changes.for_you: No chip swings yet. TSM's business is fine, so it stays bullish on fundamentals, but it has no buy zone verdict. EWT is hurt by foreign selling. NVDA and AMD are left out: TSMC's demand comments help them, but they fell with the group premarket.

changes.what: The Taiex fell 0.6%, or 289 points, to 46,822 on Oct 19 after the Philadelphia chip index dropped 3.8% on Friday; TSMC closed flat at NT$2,420 (Focus Taiwan via Ad-hoc News).
changes.for_you: No action. TSM (412.61 Friday) holding flat while the index fell is a small sign of relative strength, but it has no buy zone verdict. EWT (106.26) had up/down volume 0.79 on Friday, so sellers still lead.

changes.what: The Taiex fell 1.13% on Oct 20, then rose 594.84 points, or 1.28%, to 46,887.77 on Oct 21, led by AI server makers after Super Micro raised its September quarter revenue outlook to $18.5 to $19.5 billion (Focus Taiwan).
changes.for_you: No action before Meta's capex guide tonight. Taiwan's server makers are the first to feel a change in that number. TSM is left out of both lists because its own news has not changed.

changes.what: The Taiex fell 846.34 points, or 1.81%, to 46,041.43 on Oct 22 as US chip stocks fell 6.72%. Taipei's market was closed on Oct 23 for Typhoon Champi, so local stocks will catch up with two days of US moves on Monday.
changes.for_you: The Setups scanner listed an EWT 100 put for Nov 20 on Oct 22. If you sold it, Monday's open is the risk because Taiwan has not traded since Thursday. No new Taiwan puts until it does. TSM is left out because its own sales news has not changed.

changes.what: The Taiex fell 667.25 points, or 1.42%, to 46,368.33 on Oct 29, breaking below its quarterly moving average, as UMC hit limit down after its earnings call and Alphabet's drop weighed on AI names (BigGo Finance).
changes.for_you: No action. EWT closed at 108.94 on Oct 28 (Massive), before this drop. Do not add Taiwan puts while the index sits under its quarterly average.

changes.what: The Taiex fell 2.49% to 45,211.83 on Oct 30 after Amazon and Intel results, with a net NT$112.47 billion of foreign selling; TSMC fell 1.86% to NT$2,370 (Focus Taiwan). Trading Economics showed an intraday low near 44,922; the close from Focus Taiwan is used.
changes.for_you: No action. EWT closed at 105.99 on Oct 29 (Massive). Wait for foreign selling to ease.
